literal_meaning: পাঙ্ক্তিতে অযোগ্য বা সারিতে অযোগ্য (not fit for a row or line)
figurative_meaning_en: Insignificant; not worth mentioning; without honor or dignity
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার কথা অপাঙ্ক্তেয়, তাই আমরা আলোচনা করিনি।
example_sentences_in_english: His opinion is utterly insignificant, so we didn't discuss it.
This incident is completely not worth mentioning.
note: Derived from Sanskrit roots indicating unworthiness in social or hierarchical rows
